public_seam: QuantResearch AcceptanceSelector, PlanRunner, ReleaseTrain ledger, and quantresearch-acceptance CLI
identity_impact: Plan identity freezes phase, fixed owner SHAs, source fingerprints, source-to-direct-test mappings, argv tokens, marker policy, p95-derived timeouts, replay count, and artifact destinations.
evidence_level: Test infrastructure selects and records owner evidence without reconstructing product metrics, changing product behavior, or substituting connected outcomes.
fail_closed_behavior: Unknown fields, duplicate keys, ambiguous ownership, unmapped paths, shell strings, baseline or fingerprint drift, mutable evidence references, and missing history fail closed.
